participation.context: Reported the octavo as news, left the paper unpaid, and refused to rewrite the letter.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Took threepence, kept ninepence unpaid from becoming ninepence spent, and left her old ruling on the comedy where it was.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Did the ninepence once, and offered to set the letter by his cloak without opening it.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You gave the kitchen the size of the book and the fact of no penny. You did not pay for the quires. You left the Sunday letter folded for tomorrow.
